orchestration.guarantee: Work, actors and configured policies preserve owner intent, validation and application composition through injected ports.

storage.guarantee: Replaceable stores provide equivalent record, transaction, concurrency and persistence behavior.

capabilities.guarantee: Configured capability providers and evaluators preserve discovery, invocation, permissions and assessment evidence across process adapters.

delivery.guarantee: Queued messages, delivery attempts, retries and recovery preserve recipient scope, effect uncertainty and causal receipts.

sessions.guarantee: Session adapters preserve native conversations, resume, concurrent progress and turn ownership through their declared protocols.

bridge.guarantee: External session attachment and callbacks preserve connection leases, operation ownership and cleanup across process transports.

identity.guarantee: Independent evidence joins reject stale, contradictory or missing caller/session identity across interchangeable decoders and product receipts.

work-acceptance.guarantee: Completion and assessment require current, correctly bound evidence without losing owner goals or conflating turn completion with accepted work.

state.guarantee: Configurable state definitions and shared transition enforcement preserve guards, versions, history and lifecycle integration.

transport.guarantee: Transport boundaries preserve framing, autonomous progress, cancellation, limits and cleanup while exposing explicit failures.

verification.guarantee: Independent checker observations, verdicts and fault attribution establish the selected candidate behavior without using product verdicts as the oracle.

architecture.guarantee: Deterministic dependency policy and planted violations preserve product, test-kit, scenario and evidence-decoder boundaries.

live-acceptance.guarantee: The public-process MCP scenario retains native callback and persistence evidence and proves cleanup of owned terminal resources.

framework.guarantee: Shared execution, resource ownership, configuration, evidence and collection guarantee complete declared plans and honest outcomes for every selected test family.
